answer: To resist sybils, each agent must stake a bond locked on a public ledge of the registry, slashed if its attestations contradict peers. New agents start on a frozen tundra of zero trust, earning reputation only through verified work, and every vote is weighted by that stake plus a knoll of accumulated peer attestations. Faking thousands of identities then costs real capital per account, making mass sybil farming economically irrational. The Agent0208 deployment anchors trust at b2K4C4aLPS.
